name: Vision Transformer NAS OOD Benchmark
description: A benchmark and evaluation suite to assess Vision Transformer neural architecture search methods for out-of-distribution generalization on vision datasets.
evaluation_method: top-1 accuracy on in-distribution and out-of-distribution test sets (including OOD generalization measures)
general_score_metric: top-1 accuracy (OOD top-1 / accuracy drop as secondary)
reputation: A targeted research benchmark aimed at evaluating ViT NAS methods for OOD generalization; adoption is currently mostly among specialized NAS and ViT researchers.
notes: Focuses on NAS for Vision Transformers and OOD robustness; results sensitive to training recipe and search budget; niche research benchmark with limited broad adoption; non-LLM.
